decision: No file was copied, renamed, or admitted. Exact original resource gate remains blocked until byte-authenticated source payloads are found. See extensionAndPakCorrection. The emptied hfl/ttb name lists are the unreferenced ids, not a new derived missing total.
extensionAndPakCorrection: extensionAndPakCorrection (2026-10-24): fileNameScan searched tile_17_mou_a_*.dds, the wrong extension. Map17's original HFL references tile_17_mou_a_01..09.tga. It also used the wrong pak when a pak was consulted: the worktree PlayDH/Map.pak, whose header has 4192 entries, not the original D:\MX\client\Package\3DData\Map.pak, which reads 11267 entries to EOF. A 2026-10-21 reconciliation searched .tga across that original pak and all drives and also found nothing, so 'no original exists' stands. This is informational, not a missing-file defect. remainingExactBlockers.hfl 22 and ttb 18 are the 2026-10-17 totals and include ids that are not referenced; they are not restated as a new count.
